snippet.title: Other Mommy | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Your mommy won’t save you. Other Mommy only in theaters October 9.

Can I go inside your heart?

From James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror behind the Saw, Insidious and The Conjuring franchises—and Rob Savage, the director of bold genre films Host and The Boogeyman, comes a terrifying trip into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

Academy Award® winner Jessica Chastain (It Chapter Two, The Eyes of Tammy Faye) stars in a dual role as Bela’s mother and as “Other Mommy,” a manifestation of the entity. Jay Duplass (Transparent, Industry) plays Daddo, Bela’s father, and Arabella Olivia Clark (The Housemaid, The Hand that Rocks the Cradle) plays Bela. 

The impressive supporting cast includes Actor Award nominee Dichen Lachman (Severance), Emmy and Tony Award nominee Arian Moayed (Succession) and screen legend Karen Allen (Indiana Jones films).  

From Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Other Mommy is directed by Rob Savage from a screenplay by WGA award winner Nathan Elston, writer for the Emmy-winning sensation Succession, based on the New York Times bestselling novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman (Bird Box).

The film is produced by James Wan, p.g.a., and is executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Rob Savage, Josh Malerman and Ryan Lewis.

snippet.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall | Official Trailer | Warner Bros. Entertainment
snippet.description:
Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall finds Bruce Wayne fighting his toughest enemies including Bane. Coming to Digital on August 25, followed by a 4K UHD, Blu-ray, and DVD release on September 8.

SUBSCRIBE to Warner Bros. Entertainment: http://bit.ly/32v18jf

Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane! 
Based on the iconic DC comic book event, Batman: Knightfall – Part 1: Knightfall tells the story of the breaking of the Bat.

snippet.title: I DIDN'T Love the Avengers: Doomsday Trailer...
snippet.description:
YOU CAN’T JUST CASUALLY DROP AN AVENGERS TRAILER ON ME LIKE THAT!? ARE YOU INSANE!? At least now we FINALLY know what to expect from Doomsday after years of wondering how Marvel would make the Doctor Doom pivot work. Even with all my hesitations, I’m happy to admit that this trailer moved me. I’m only human, you show me a bunch of superheroes interacting and I’m going to get excited! But overall, I honestly don’t know how to feel about this movie. I WANT it to be great, I WANT it to subvert my expectations, I WANTED the first PROPER trailer would ease my concerns, but it’s kinda funny to think that the two biggest selling points are what I’m most worried about.

snippet.description:

Planet Zoo 2 is coming to PC, Xbox Series X|S & PlayStation 5 on October 13! 🐦 🐟

Soar to great heights with flying birds, prepare your diving suits as fully-aquatic species make a splash, and take your conservation efforts beyond your zoo in brand-new Wildlife Reserves!

snippet.title: The Minecraft Void is Not Infinite.
snippet.description:
25 million blocks below the void, land begins to generate...

JOIN OR DIE: https://discord.gg/3PwwWDAugZ

email me: sawyercontent3@gmail.com

thank you channel members : )

IF YOU THINK THIS IS FAKE, READ:
This is an adventure story following my travels through the theoretical limits of Minecraft and to the very bottom of a world. The minimum build limit makes the Voidlands impossible to reach, but by removing it Minecraft will generate the Voidlands just as it generates any other terrain.

Cubic chunks was used to remove minimum build limit and an offset was used past 2 billion blocks because MC won’t let you go there at all.

oh... and I maybe took some "creative freedom" going forward about halfway through the video. I felt that it got a little dull past around 10m blocks so I fixed that.

MORE INFO ABOUT THE VOIDLANDS:
https://youtu.be/-w6okOz-iNs?is=zYs8How7SuOAOOyK

snippet.title: Splatoon Raiders Review
snippet.description:
Splatoon Raiders reviewed by Logan Plant on Nintendo Switch 2.

Splatoon Raiders is an amazing action RPG with an expertly executed loop. It has fantastic new powers with crazy upgrades that are worth chasing, tough battles that force you to put care into your build in order to overcome them, and a huge variety of fun level types to jump between. The pacing, balance, and difficulty curve are very impressive: I always had to work to get better, but none of the campaign ever felt like grinding or needless padding. Raiders stays fresh by constantly introducing deeper ways to customize my abilities that spark new ideas for creative combinations. I reached the credits more than 20 hours ago, but thanks to an overpowered endgame worth coming back for and the option to seamlessly play with friends online, I’ve got plenty of raiding left to do. This is the best Splatoon campaign yet and one of the top games on Switch 2.

What happens when the Avengers, Fantastic Four, X-Men and Doctor Doom finally collide in one of the biggest Marvel movies ever made? Today I’m reacting to the trailer for **Avengers: Doomsday**, one of the most anticipated superhero movies in years. If you enjoy honest trailer reaction content, Marvel discussions, movie breakdowns and reactions to the biggest upcoming films, you’ve come to the right place!

In this **Avengers: Doomsday trailer reaction**, I break down the biggest moments from the trailer, the return of the Avengers, the arrival of Doctor Doom, the massive crossover potential and why this finally feels like Marvel returning to true event-movie mode.

What makes **Avengers: Doomsday** so exciting is that this does not look like another smaller chapter in the MCU. This feels like several generations of Marvel storytelling finally colliding in one massive film.

The Avengers are back.

The Fantastic Four are entering the larger universe.

Classic X-Men characters are joining the fight.

And Robert Downey Jr. is returning to Marvel as Doctor Doom.

That combination immediately makes this one of the most fascinating and potentially risky projects Marvel Studios has ever attempted. Robert Downey Jr. helped define the MCU as Tony Stark, so seeing him step into the role of one of Marvel’s greatest villains creates an enormous amount of excitement, curiosity and pressure.

The trailer promises massive action, multiversal stakes, emotional reunions and the kind of crossover spectacle fans have been waiting for since **Avengers: Endgame**. It finally feels like Marvel is building toward something important again rather than simply introducing disconnected characters and stories.

The return of directors Joe and Anthony Russo also makes **Avengers: Doomsday** even more interesting. After directing **Captain America: The Winter Soldier**, **Captain America: Civil War**, **Avengers: Infinity War** and **Avengers: Endgame**, they understand how to balance enormous casts, emotional character arcs and large-scale action.

Now they have the difficult task of bringing together the Avengers, Fantastic Four, X-Men and Doctor Doom while making the movie feel like more than a collection of cameos.

snippet.title: Ambush Story Time with Mariko Baika | Overwatch
snippet.description:
Lady Shion is called to account for the events in Tokyo, but she’s ready to rebalance the scales.

Join Mariko Baika, the voice actor behind Shion, for a reading of our newest short story, ‘Ambush.’

In the aftermath of Overwatch and the Yōkai’s strikes on the Hashimoto Clan, Lady Shion is summoned to a meeting of the Hashimoto elders. Though the other elders believe she has much to answer for, Shion is happy to remind the elders that the only one she answers to…is herself.

Play Overwatch, Season 3, available now.

Read by Mariko Baika as Shion

Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game, or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms. Roblox is a global platform where millions of people gather together every day to imagine, create, and share experiences with each other in immersive, user-generated 3D worlds. The types of gameplay on Roblox are just as limitless as the imagination of the creators themselves. What is Roblox? snippet.title: Terra Invicta Dark Skies E1: A Very Different Alien Invasion (Brutal, 2003 Scenario)
snippet.description:
Welcome Back.... all the way to 2003.

Terra Invicta Dark Skies is almost here and it brings with it new shipsets and two new scenarios that change up the game.

 Broken Earth brings the alien invasion to a post-apocalyptic future while 2003 offers a challenge of dealing with an (initially at least) much stealthier alien infiltration with a world that is less technologically advanced and much less comfortable in space than the familiar setting of 2026.

2003 comes with a challenge warning and an even longer timeline than a regular TI game. So let's dial up to brutal difficulty, take the helm of the initiative, and head to Moscow circa 2003.

Note - this is a preview version of the DLC and may differ from the release version

snippet.title: Hermitcraft S11#12: Parkour + Golf = Parkolf?
snippet.description:
The Minecraft - "Chaos Cubed" update has hit Hermitcraft and everyone is buzzing with Minigames.

We check out a surface Sulfur Cave to collect the new materials. We give some of West Tunnel's minigames a try. Inspired, I finally get started working on the minigames for Prospect Hunters by seeing what kind of Mini Golf type game we can make with the Sulfur Cubes.

We finish things off with xB's Air Hockey, Docm's Pool Table, and Zedaph's ITSLAM card game.

Hermitcraft Website: http://www.hermitcraft.com
Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/EthoLP
